title: I am now absolutely certain that Mallworld is a universe that does not exist only in our minds

classification.theory_summary: Author argues Mallworld is a fixed/shared place consciousness travels to; mentions recurring same place and meeting people known only in dreams; speculates others may not remember.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scene description, locations, layout, connections, or events—only general claims about recurrence and meeting dream-people.

meta.author_theory: Mallworld is described as a fixed place not in the subconscious; author suggests consciousness travels to it during sleep; possibility of shared Mallworld where others may not remember due to different planes/times/frequency.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content limited to recurrence frequency (same place seen >10 times), long-term dream journaling, and presence of dream-only familiar people; no describable setting features provided (no specific mall/school/hotel areas, no sensory qualities, no navigation).
